name: rumble-publicworks
description: Advanced server-authoritative public works jobs for Rumble Framework

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:server && npm run typecheck:client
scripts.build:server: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs tsconfig.server.json dist/server.js
scripts.build:client: tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node scripts/bundle.mjs tsconfig.client.json dist/client.js
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run check:dist
